exposure: skin closure through skin staples plus waterproof wound dressings (SSWWD)
cohort: 4266 women aged 18-49 years who underwent in-hospital low transverse cesarean delivery
finding: Cesarean delivery skin closure with 2OPMT was associated with lower rates of in-hospital infection and wound complications, shorter length of hospital stay, and lower total hospital costs compared to SSWWD.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery skin closure using 2-octyl cyanoacrylate plus polymer mesh tape (2OPMT) was associated with lower rates of in-hospital infection and wound complications, shorter length of stay, and lower total hospital costs compared to skin closure with skin staples plus waterproof wound dressings.
